title: Global Imagery Browse Services, WMTS
attribution: We acknowledge the use of imagery provided by services from NASA's Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS), part of NASA's Earth Science Data and Information System (ESDIS)

use.en: Earth weather layers from satellites and reanalysis (VIIRS and MODIS clouds, IMERG precipitation, MERRA-2 surface air temperature), and the Earth's surface imagery streamed on approach, only for the patch of ground in view: the Blue Marble mosaic of August 2004 by default, or, when chosen in the settings, the VIIRS image of the scene's day, the shaded relief with bathymetry, or the Black Marble night lights of 2016. Its MODIS/SRTM water mask is also read once, offline, to bring the Earth's relief to the level of its water.
use.fr: Couches météo terrestres issues de satellites et de réanalyse (nuages VIIRS et MODIS, précipitations IMERG, température de l’air en surface MERRA-2), et imagerie de la surface de la Terre streamée à l’approche, seulement pour la portion de sol visible : la mosaïque Blue Marble d’août 2004 par défaut, ou, si le réglage la choisit, l’image VIIRS du jour de la scène, le relief ombré avec bathymétrie ou les lumières nocturnes Black Marble de 2016. Son masque d’eau MODIS/SRTM est aussi lu une fois, hors ligne, pour ramener le relief de la Terre au niveau de son eau.
use.es: Capas meteorológicas terrestres por satélite y reanálisis (nubes VIIRS y MODIS, precipitación IMERG, temperatura del aire en superficie MERRA-2), e imágenes de la superficie terrestre transmitidas al acercarse, solo para la porción de suelo visible: el mosaico Blue Marble de agosto de 2004 por defecto o, si se elige en los ajustes, la imagen VIIRS del día de la escena, el relieve sombreado con batimetría o las luces nocturnas Black Marble de 2016. Su máscara de agua MODIS/SRTM también se lee una vez, fuera de línea, para devolver el relieve de la Tierra al nivel de su agua.
use.pt-BR: Camadas meteorológicas terrestres por satélite e reanálise (nuvens VIIRS e MODIS, precipitação IMERG, temperatura do ar na superfície MERRA-2), e imagens da superfície da Terra transmitidas na aproximação, somente para a porção de solo visível: o mosaico Blue Marble de agosto de 2004 por padrão ou, se escolhida nas configurações, a imagem VIIRS do dia da cena, o relevo sombreado com batimetria ou as luzes noturnas Black Marble de 2016. Sua máscara de água MODIS/SRTM também é lida uma vez, offline, para levar o relevo da Terra ao nível da sua água.

terms.en: NASA supports full and open sharing of data; GIBS states no restriction and no rate limit (read at the source on 2026-10-12). It asks clients to acknowledge it: “We acknowledge the use of imagery provided by services from NASA's Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS), part of NASA's Earth Science Data and Information System (ESDIS).”
terms.fr: La NASA soutient le partage complet et ouvert des données ; GIBS n’indique ni restriction ni limite de débit (lu à la source le 2026-10-12). Il demande aux clients de le citer : « We acknowledge the use of imagery provided by services from NASA's Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS), part of NASA's Earth Science Data and Information System (ESDIS). »
terms.es: La NASA apoya el intercambio completo y abierto de datos; GIBS no indica ninguna restricción ni límite de caudal (leído en la fuente el 2026-10-12). Pide a los clientes que lo citen: «We acknowledge the use of imagery provided by services from NASA's Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS), part of NASA's Earth Science Data and Information System (ESDIS).»
terms.pt-BR: A NASA apoia o compartilhamento completo e aberto de dados; o GIBS não indica nenhuma restrição nem limite de vazão (lido na fonte em 2026-10-12). Ele pede aos clientes que o citem: “We acknowledge the use of imagery provided by services from NASA's Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS), part of NASA's Earth Science Data and Information System (ESDIS).”
